verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules or automation engine in Zulip that triggers actions on events. The interactive bot framework requires writing and running custom bot code, which is a developer building block. Zapier and IFTTT are third-party tools, and incoming webhooks only bring data into Zulip, so neither counts as the product's own event-triggered rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
